body:
paysafecard is a prepaid voucher system, and it is accepted as one of our gift card payment choices at One Stop Vape Store. It is popular with people who prefer to pay in cash at a retailer or who want to avoid using a card online. Paying with paysafecard earns our 10% gift card discount. This guide explains how to get a voucher, what you receive, how to upload the PIN through our private link, how to handle balances that fall short, how long verification takes and how to keep the PIN protected. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## What paysafecard is
paysafecard is a prepaid payment method sold as vouchers. Each voucher includes a 16-digit PIN, and the PIN represents the balance. You buy a voucher for a fixed amount, and anyone who has the PIN can spend it, which is why we ask you to upload it only through the private link in your order email. Vouchers are sold online and at many retail locations, and the amounts offered vary by retailer.

## Get a voucher
Visit [paysafecard](https://www.paysafecard.com/en-us/) and use the buy or where-to-buy options to purchase a voucher for the exact amount due. Availability varies by location and retailer. Many convenience stores and supermarkets sell vouchers in set amounts, and some retailers let you buy online. Check the amount in our order email, and choose a voucher that matches as closely as you can.

## What you receive
A voucher includes a 16-digit PIN. For online purchases it is shown on screen and emailed; for physical vouchers it is printed on a receipt. Keep the receipt, and do not use the PIN yourself. Treat it like cash: if you lose it or someone sees it, the balance can be spent by someone else.

## Upload the PIN
Use the private link in our order email. Enter the PIN, add a photo of the voucher or purchase receipt, and submit. We verify the PIN and mark your order paid. The link contains a unique token, so only someone who has it can open the page, and uploads are private. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/) for tips on getting a clear photo. If you bought more than one voucher to reach the amount, add each PIN and receipt.

## Matching the amount
Vouchers come in fixed amounts. If you cannot match the amount exactly, buy the next amount up and tell us in the notes so we can review it with you. If the amount due is larger than a single voucher, buy two or more and upload all the PINs. Please do not buy more than you need, because we cannot return unused balance to you.

## What happens after you upload
We check the PIN and its balance and match it to your order. This is a manual check by our team, so it is quickest during business hours, Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. When it is verified, we mark the order as paid and email you a confirmation. The order then enters processing, which takes 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse, and ships with tracking by USPS or UPS. An adult aged 21 or older must sign on delivery. See [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/) and [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/).

## A worked example
Suppose your cart is $150. Paying with a gift card applies the 10% discount of $15.00, so the product total is $135.00. Because that is under $200, the flat $15 shipping fee applies, and the amount due is $150.00. At a store you might buy a $100 voucher and a $50 voucher, which together equal the amount due. You upload both PINs and your receipts through the private link, and we verify them. For comparison, the same cart paid by Cash App has no discount and totals $165.00. See [the 10% crypto and gift card discount](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/).

## Common issues
- **Not enough balance:** buy another voucher and upload both PINs.
- **Voucher not found online:** try a retail location; many convenience stores sell them.
- **Typo in the PIN:** check each digit before sending.
- **Voucher already used:** tell us right away, because a used voucher has no balance to verify.
- **Lost receipt:** keep a photo of the voucher or the receipt until we confirm.

## Tips
Keep the receipt until we confirm. Do not use the voucher yourself. Only send the PIN through our official link. Buy from the official site or a reputable retailer, never from a marketplace seller offering a discount.

## Why choose it
It is useful if you prefer to pay in cash at a retailer or want to avoid a card payment. It is also easy to buy in small amounts that add up to the total. It counts toward our 10% gift card discount, so you save as much as you would with crypto.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Do I need a paysafecard account?
You do not need an account to buy a voucher. You only need to upload the PIN through our private link.

### Can I combine vouchers?
Yes. If one voucher does not cover the amount, buy several and upload all the PINs and receipts.

### Is it slower than crypto?
Usually, because a person checks each PIN. See [gift card or crypto, which is better](/blog/gift-card-vs-crypto-which-is-better/).

### What happens to leftover balance?
We cannot return unused balance. Buy only what you need, or tell us in advance if you will have a surplus so we can note it against your order.

## Staying protected
Never post a PIN online, ignore messages that ask you to pay with a voucher outside our order link and buy only from the official site or a reputable retailer. Read [gift card code security tips](/blog/gift-card-code-security-tips/) before you buy.

## Related guides
Read [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/) and compare other cards: [Apple](/blog/pay-with-apple-gift-card/), [Razer Gold](/blog/pay-with-razer-gold/), [Sephora](/blog/pay-with-sephora-gift-card/) and [Macy's](/blog/pay-with-macys-gift-card/). Browse the [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) range when you are ready. All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Understanding fixed denominations
Gift cards are sold in set amounts, and that shapes how you plan a paysafecard voucher payment. Start from the amount due in our order email, then look at the amounts the seller offers. If the exact figure is there, buy it. If not, you have three sensible options. The first is to buy the next amount up and tell us in the notes, which keeps the purchase simple at the cost of a small surplus that we cannot return. The second is to combine two cards that add up to the amount, for example one larger card and one small one, and upload both. The third is to adjust your cart slightly, adding or removing an item so that the amount due lands on an available denomination, which you can do before you pay by contacting us. Whichever you choose, tell us in the notes so that the person verifying your payment knows what to expect. Mismatches that are explained up front are resolved quickly, while unexplained ones take longer.

## Planning the timing of a paysafecard voucher order
A gift card order has two phases, and it helps to plan around both. The first phase is yours: buying the card, finding the details and uploading them, which usually takes ten to twenty minutes if you have a payment method ready. The second phase is ours: a person checks the card and matches it to your order, which is quickest during business hours, Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. If you place the order in the evening, buy the card straight away and upload it, and expect the check the next business morning. If you place it on a Friday afternoon, expect the check on Monday. Orders begin processing only after the payment is confirmed, so the sooner you upload, the sooner the 24 to 72 business hours of processing start. Unpaid orders may be released after 24 hours, so do not leave the purchase until the last minute.

## Buying with cash at a retailer
One of the reasons people choose paysafecard is that vouchers can be bought with cash at many retail locations. If you do this, ask the cashier for a voucher for the amount you need, check the amount on the receipt and keep the receipt. The PIN is printed on the receipt or the voucher, and you should photograph it clearly in good light, with all 16 digits visible. Do not leave the receipt in a pocket that goes through the wash, and do not share a photo of it anywhere except through our private link. If the cashier cannot sell the exact amount, buy the next amount up or combine two vouchers.

## A final checklist for a paysafecard payment
1. Buy from the official site or a reputable retailer.
2. Check the amount on the receipt.
3. Photograph the voucher or receipt with all 16 digits visible.
4. Upload the PIN and the receipt through the private link.
5. Do not spend the voucher yourself.

If everything on the list is ticked, your payment should be verified without any questions. If something is unclear, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) or WhatsApp before you upload, and we will help. Remember that all products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

From the official paysafecard site or its where-to-buy options at retailers such as convenience stores.
The PIN and a photo of the voucher or your purchase receipt, through the private link in your order email.

Yes. Gift card payments save 10% on your product subtotal.

faq.a: No. Do not spend it, or it will have no balance to verify.
